checks.why: a factory returns an object literal typed by an interface; a call to the interface member reaches the literal's property, because the literal implements the member it is named after (#1208)
and an object-literal METHOD implements the member the same way
a literal bound to a const declared as the interface implements it too
a function read out of an array of tuples into a local and called: the call is typed through the element type, and the function written as that type is what runs
want: calls it through a field, variable or parameter that holds it

checks.why: a call on an expression callee runs every branch: an object-literal property passed as the argument reaches the call through the field it is stored in
and the other branch, a declared function, is run by the same call
a call through a STATIC function-typed field resolves to the field's function type, as the compiler says; it resolved to nothing, so the type had no caller
